title.narrative: National normative framework exits to enable diversion of children in conflict with law(52788), Text

target.value: 2022:Yes - the framework is approved and implementation has begun

actual.value: 2022:Negotiations have started with the Mediation Boards Commission on the use of existing legislation for diversion and expansion of its scope.

title.narrative: Existence of a strengthened system for adolescent participation, Text

baseline.value: Score 1 (There is limited system for adolescent participation. The system does not have more than 2 of the key elements listed in Score 4)

target.value: 2022:Score 3 : Implementation of adolescent participation road map

actual.value: 2022:The report on adolescent participation for children in care and in children’s clubs was finalized in January 2022. The roadmap for strengthening adolescent participation has not yet been developed.

title.narrative: Police Women and Children desks operate according to Child and Women friendly guidelines(52787), Text

baseline.value: Score 1: Child and women friendly police guideline is available

target.value: 2022:Score 3: At least 50 % women and children desk police officers trained on these guidelines

actual.value: 2022:324 police or 49 % of the specialist police force for women and children were trained on managing victims and perpetrators in line with the guidelines.
